text:
mel: Heads up — preflight for chart v2.4.1 on payments-eu hit a values merge conflict during canary in eu-west. deploy-bot: Deploy blocked: values-merge-check failed (checksum mismatch). See /deploy/logs/3498765432 for details.
raj: looking now. which values set? tenant-scoped or global?
sophia: tenant config override for tenant-id=acme, values/overrides.yaml differs from chart defaults. small diff but admission webhook rejects.
mel: exact error: "Error: merged values failed schema validation: path \"spec.replicas\" expected integer got string"
oliver: ugh, that explains it — last change was a fast follow that changed replicas to "3" in a patch.
raj: can we hotpatch the canary to the previous values and re-run canary? manual rollback for the canary only?
sophia: yes, we can pin the canary to chart v2.4.0 and apply overrides from blue/values-acme.yaml. then re-evaluate.
mel: constraints: we have a scheduled change window in 30m for EU payments. if we don't get green, ops wants full rollback of the promotion.
oliver: proposed plan: (1) manual pin canary to v2.4.0, (2) apply corrected overrides (replicas as integer), (3) re-run preflight, (4) if green within 15m rollforward, else rollback.
raj: thumbs. How to pin? helm release patch or annotate deploy-bot?
sophia: easiest is to patch the release annotation so deploy-bot will skip promoting the v2.4.1 family. run: 
```
kubectl -n payments patch deployment payments-canary --type=json -p='[{"op":"replace","path":"/metadata/annotations/chart-version","value":"2.4.0"}]'
```
then trigger deploy-bot re-eval: `/deploy re-evaluate 3498765432 --reason manual-pin`
mel: i'll do the patch. will also open a tiny PR to fix the values type for replicas.
deploy-bot: Action queued: manual-pin request received by mel. Waiting for 2 approvals because this touches tenant overrides.
raj: approving now.
oliver: approving.
sophia: quick note for release notes: include that acme tenant had value type mismatch causing canary hold, fixed by casting replicas to int; no user-facing downtime. Add small blurb under "canary hiccups".
mel: done, PR + changelog entry linked: https://git.internal/r/3498.
raj: if preflight still fails after pin+fix, fallback is full chart rollback (promote_v2.3.9). we should pre-stage the rollback manifest in case we need to flip fast.
oliver: i'll prepare the rollback job and keep it paused. command: `/deploy schedule-rollback payments eu-west 3498765432 --target 2.3.9 --hold`
mel: timeline: pin now (T+2m), fix values (T+5m), preflight (T+8-18m). if green, unhold and promote before change window. if not, release lead will approve automated rollback.
sophia: tagging @oncall-eu to watch the window.
raj: thanks — i'll monitor logs and kube events. dropping into payments canary channel to follow
